name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection (immunity) of Grzegorz Braun, a Polish member of the European Parliament. Polish prosecutors want to charge him over statements he made in 2025, in which he is accused of publicly denying the crimes committed at the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp. Lifting his immunity means the Polish case can go ahead. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to harm his political work.

- **What changes:** Braun loses his protection from prosecution in Poland, so the criminal case can proceed.
- **Who it affects:** Grzegorz Braun, a member of the European Parliament elected in Poland.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to Polish prosecutors and to Braun.
